content: 'Apɨrahami kemɨtiumɨ
Merikɨtsɨ 'Apɨrahami tawarita 'ukaratsi kaniutiwitɨni Tsetura titewakame.
Mɨkɨ hamatɨa yuniwema kaniwarayexeiya: Tsimɨrani, Kutsani, Merani, Mariyani, 'Itsiwaki 'imatɨrieka Tsuhaki.
Kutsani Tsawa paapaya kanayani meta Rerani. Rerani nuiwarimama mekanakɨne 'atsureutsixi, retutseutsixi, rehumeutsixi.
Mariyani niwemama mekanakɨne, 'Epa, 'Epexi, Kanuki, 'Awiraha, 'imatɨrieka 'Eriraha. 'Ikɨ yunaitɨ Tsetura niwemama mekanihɨkɨtɨni.
'Apɨrahami yuniwe 'Itsahaki naime katiniyetuirieni tita mɨrexeiyakai.
Meta 'Apɨrahami hipame yɨ'ɨitama waniwema tiwayetuirieka kaniwarenɨ'ani, mexi'akuxi 'a'uyeikakai, 'Itsahaki hamatɨa memɨkatitenikɨ, tau manatineika hepatsie kaniwarenɨ'ani.
'Apɨrahami kaniutihuni xeitsienituyari heimana haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'auxɨwi (175) wiyari.
Mɨya paɨmexɨa 'utihuka 'Apɨrahami kaniumɨni waɨkawa 'ukiratsitɨtɨri, tutsimama memakuhe wahetsɨa kaneyani.
Niwemama 'Itsahaki meta 'Itsimaheri meyunaitɨ mekanika'awieta terɨta Makipera mɨrakutewatsie Mamɨre 'aurie, 'Epuruni kwieyatsie, Heti tewiyari Tsukaxi nu'aya.
'Apɨrahami minanekai pɨhɨkɨtɨkai hetitsixi muwarunanairiekai, muwa mekaneitateni 'ɨyaya Tsara hamatɨa.
Hikɨ 'Apɨrahami 'ukumawereku, Kakaɨyari 'Itsahaki 'aixɨa kaniuyurieni 'Apɨrahami nu'aya, putsu 'aurie kaniuyuhayewa «'Amuyeika Mɨnetsixeiya» mɨtitewa 'aurie.
'Itsimaheri nuiwarimama
'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni 'Itsimaheri nuiwarimama, 'Apɨrahami nu'aya Hakari hetsie meyexei, 'ekipitutanaka Tsara parewiwameya.
Mɨpaɨ mekatenitetewaka 'Itsimaheri niwemama: Newayuti, Tseraxi, 'Ariweheri, Miwitsani,
Mitsima, Rumaha, Matsa,
Haraxi, Temaha, Ketuxi, Napitsi meta Tserema.
'Ikɨ mepɨhɨkɨ 'Itsimaheri niwemama, tamamata heimana huta nuiwarite mepakɨ kememɨtetetewa yaxeikɨa, yuxexuitɨ kwie mehexeiyatɨ mepakɨ me'ukutetɨkaitɨ.
'Itsimaheri xeitsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atahuta (137) wiyari puyeikakai. Kaniumɨni tutsimama memakuhe wahetsɨa kaneyani.
Nuiwarimama Kawira mekaniuyuhayewa meta Tsuhuxi, 'Ekipitu 'aurie mekatenitekaitɨni, huye 'Atsiriya haneme manuyehanetsie, mana mekaniuyuhayewa yu'iwama mewaraye'unietɨ.
Kakuwu meta 'Etsahu kememɨte'ununuiwaxɨ
'Ikɨ 'Itsahaki kemuyɨ pɨ'ɨxatsiyari, 'Apɨrahami nu'aya.
'Itsahaki huta tewiyari wiyari kanexeiyakaitɨni kepauka Xeweka mutiwitɨ, Wetuheri niweya, Rawani taruya. Wetuheri Rawani hamatɨa 'arameu teɨteriyari mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai Parani-'Arami mepɨkiekataritɨkai.
Hikɨ Xeweka pɨkaniwewekai, 'ayumieme 'Itsahaki Yawé kaniutawawirieni hetsiena mieme, hikɨ Yawé kani'enieni nenewierieya, Xeweka kaniutihukata.

Peru hukayahetsie paitɨ meyetetɨ yuhutatɨ tɨɨri mekaniyukwitɨwekaitɨni, mɨkɨ 'ayumieme mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Xɨka mɨpaɨ netiuka'eniwamɨkɨ, ¿titayari 'anetiuyeikani?» Hikɨ Yawé kaniutahɨawe kanita'iwawiya.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya:
Hikɨ Xeweka kepauka maye'atɨarie matiniwenitsie, yuhutame kaniwarayexeiya tɨɨri.
Matɨari mutinuiwaxɨ kɨpateya kanitataɨrawikaitɨni, naitɨ hauhuxatɨ. 'Etsahu mekateniterɨwa.
'Utɨmanata mutinuiwaxɨ yu'iwa 'Etsahu keputsayatsie 'awietɨ kaniutinuiwa. Mɨkɨ Kakuwu mekateniterɨwa. Kepauka mɨkɨ tɨɨri yuhutatɨ memutinunuiwaxɨ 'Itsahaki haika tewiyari wiyari kanexeiyakaitɨni.
Tɨɨri mekaniutiwawere. 'Etsahu yeuta kaninakekaitɨni, yeutari kwinimieme tiwareutakwiwetɨ kanayani. Kakuwu meta kayuwatɨ muyeika kanayani, yukie mukani kaninakekaitɨni.
'Itsahaki matsi waɨkawa 'Etsahu kaninaki'eriekaitɨni, minakekaikɨ xɨ'erikaya mɨtikwaka, Xeweka matsi Kakuwu waɨkawa kaninaki'eriekaitɨni.
Hikɨ Kakuwu pɨtiyuwewiriekai tikwanike, mana 'Etsahu kaninuani 'uxetɨ yeuta hanuyaka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe:
—Netineumikwa mɨkɨ 'itsari mɨxetakɨ, kwinimieme nepɨti'uxe. ('Ayumieme 'Etsahu 'Erumi pɨtiuterɨwarie).
Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Keneneutuiriekameri heitserie kepemɨrexeiya 'ekɨ meri pemɨmiemekɨ.
'Etsahu mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Haakakɨ nepɨmɨxime, tixaɨtɨkɨ pɨkatiyunaki'erie heitserie kenemɨrexeiya nemexɨakametɨtɨ.

Kakuwu matsi tawarita mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kamɨtsɨ keneneutuiri heitserie kepemɨrexeiya yanetineutahɨawi 'aheyemekɨ. 'Etsahu yurikɨ yakaniutayɨni, mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniyetuirieni heitserie kemɨrexeiyakai mexɨakametɨtɨ.

Kakuwu 'Etsahu katiniumini mume 'etsimɨpepe 'itsariyarikɨ meta paa kanimini. Hikɨ tiukwaka 'anutihareka kaneyani. Mɨpaɨ tiuyurieka tixaɨtɨ katiyunaki'erikame payeitɨa heitserie kemɨrexeiyakai mexɨakametɨtɨ.
